messages.text:
Hi Camille, your B30 and the Power K. (order Shop····) will ship together from our Canadian warehouse by November 30.

I'm sorry. We told you November 7, and then mid-November in our November 3 email, and both dates slipped. The B30s are arriving at our warehouses now. Your tracking number will be emailed to you as soon as the box leaves.

You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I only see the B30 order on this email. Is the Magic M. order under a different address?

Thanks Camille. Shop···· is the order I pulled up. It's your B30 with the Power K., and both are going to (address hidden) from our Ontario warehouse by November 30. Nothing has changed since my last message. They're still waiting on the incoming B30 stock, and the tracking will come to your email when they ship.

Was there something else you wanted to know about this order, or are you looking for the Magic M.?

Your Magic M. 40T is order Shop····, Camille. I found it by your name and the (address hidden) postcode. It was placed under a different email address from this one, which is why it didn't come up at first.

It's paid and ships by November 30 from our Ontario warehouse. All 300 units have left the factory and are on their way to our warehouses. Tracking goes to the email on that order once yours ships, so it's worth checking that inbox too. You can follow the shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Yes, that's the one. Shop···· is your Magic M. 40T. It's paid and ships by November 30, and there's no tracking yet because it hasn't left our warehouse.

Is there something specific you'd like to do with this order, like change the address or the email the updates go to? Or were you just after the number?
